aipconnect-aipconnect:lever:a2279112-877.title: Medical Communications Director
aipconnect-aipconnect:lever:a2279112-877.description: Open Vacancy: This role is a current, active position and we are accepting applications. Our client, a Life Sciences consultancy, is seeking a strategic and entrepreneurial Medical Communications Director to help expand the agency’s service offerings. The ideal candidate will have a strong foundation in scientific and clinical writing, experience in HCP and patient education, expertise in digital communications, a client-focused approach, and the ability to present and interpret data with impact. This role will have three primary areas of focus: 1. Provide scientific and medical writing services across multiple projects and program types. 2. Oversee and manage outsourced medical writing support. 3. Provide therapeutic leadership and expertise to internal teams, healthcare professionals, and clients.
responsibilities: Strategic Planning:

Ensure integration of brand strategy, client insights, and continuity of messaging and therapeutic data across a range of documents and programs (e.g., meeting reports, education programs, practice assessments, feasibility assessments, steering committee assignments).
Support content accuracy for layout, production, and delivery of digital projects.
Develop scientific/medical content for proposals and business development opportunities.
Manage content creation and quality for assigned projects, including freelance writers.
Manage Scientific Planning Committees for program development.
Provide guidance on accreditation requirements and processes (e.g., CCCEP, CFPC, Royal College).
Monitor emerging therapeutics and market developments to inform client work and business growth.
Develop meeting and workshop outputs/reports as defined in project scope.
Business Development:
Identify new opportunities with clients and in new therapeutic areas.
Source and prepare grant submissions.
Contribute to proposals and pitches for new projects and service offerings.
Program Delivery & Oversight:
Develop frameworks, templates, and style guides for editorial content.
Train and enforce editorial guidelines across internal and external writers.
Manage briefing, sourcing, and oversight of freelance medical writers.
Ensure delivery of high-quality reports, project outputs, and educational content within timelines and budgets.
Research and source tools, reports, and templates to enhance service offerings.
Stakeholder & KOL Relations:
Build and maintain relationships with key opinion leaders (KOLs) and stakeholder organizations in relevant therapeutic areas.
Support engagement, training, and mentoring of staff.
Create partnership opportunities that align with future initiatives.
Client Services:
Maintain and strengthen client relationships through proactive communication and delivery excellence.
Act as a trusted partner by addressing client needs promptly and thoroughly.
Develop required documents for client coordination, facilitation, and reporting.
qualifications: Advanced degree in life sciences, medicine, pharmacy, or a related healthcare field required; PhD or Master’s degree strongly preferred.
Minimum 8–10 years of experience in medical communications, scientific writing, or related areas, including experience within a medical communications agency environment.
Experience managing medical writers and overseeing scientific content development across a range of medical communications deliverables.
Strong understanding of accreditation processes, regulatory standards, and compliance requirements within the healthcare/pharmaceutical landscape.
Proven track record of client service, strategic insight, and successful project delivery.
Excellent scientific writing, communication, and presentation skills, with the ability to translate complex data into clear, compelling narratives.
Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities simultaneously in a fast-paced, client-driven environment.

jobgether-jobgether:lever:408b720c-60d3-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Software Engineer ETRM based in India. As a Senior Software Engineer, you will help build and evolve next-generation Energy Trading and Risk Management software used by power and gas trading organizations across Europe. You will work within a small, innovative engineering team using a modern Microsoft technology stack. The role combines hands-on software development with technical design, testing, maintenance, and continuous improvement. You will contribute to solutions supporting complex energy markets shaped by decarbonization, changing regulations, and increasing market volatility. You will have opportunities to work with cloud technologies, APIs, distributed systems, and modern software engineering practices. Identify opportunities to improve applications, development processes, performance, and maintainability. Develop and maintain appropriate technical and product documentation, including release notes and supporting development documentation. Collaborate with team members using Agile methodologies and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives. Mentor, coach, and share knowledge with other engineers to strengthen team capability and engineering standards. Contribute to the evolution of the platform and future integration with cloud-native algorithmic power trading solutions. Requirements Strong professional experience in software engineering, with proven ownership of software development projects and technical solutions. Strong proficiency in C# and experience with Microsoft .NET Framework and/or .NET Core/.NET 6/7. Solid experience with Microsoft SQL Server and relational database development. Good understanding of application security principles and secure software development practices. Experience developing and integrating REST APIs. Strong understanding of software engineering fundamentals, testing, debugging, source control, and continuous integration. Experience working with Agile development methodologies and translating requirements into technical solutions. Demonstrated ability to interpret written requirements and technical specifications. Strong problem-solving skills, with a proactive approach to identifying issues and delivering effective solutions. Our partner is looking for a Technical Writer - PostgreSQL based in Australia. This is an opportunity to join a distributed open-source software team focused on PostgreSQL and related database technologies. You’ll own the creation of clear, accurate, and user-oriented technical documentation across the product lifecycle. Working closely with engineers, product managers, QA, and fellow technical writers, you’ll turn complex technical concepts into practical resources for diverse audiences. This is a senior, cross-functional role connecting business strategy, data science, technology, and client delivery. You will help turn complex data and analytical capabilities into practical solutions that improve business performance. The role combines operational leadership with product-oriented thinking and hands-on Agile development management. You will coordinate high-impact data science workstreams across strategy, growth, finance, technology, and other teams. You will also support client engagements, workshops, and business development opportunities by translating technical insights into clear business value. jobgether-jobgether:lever:b43aa1d8-fe6b-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Digital Marketing & E-Commerce Growth Manager based in India. This is a commercially focused role for a digital marketing professional who can turn online visibility into measurable revenue growth. You’ll own strategies across SEO, AEO, GEO, paid advertising, email marketing, landing pages, and e-commerce optimisation. Your focus will be on generating qualified B2B leads, increasing online sales, and strengthening customer acquisition and retention. You’ll work across diverse customer segments and extensive product catalogues, connecting marketing activity directly to commercial outcomes. The role combines strategic ownership with hands-on execution, experimentation, analytics, and continuous optimisation. It’s an ideal opportunity for an analytical, results-driven professional who wants their work measured by revenue, conversions, and sustainable business growth. Develop and execute an inbound marketing strategy focused on generating qualified B2B enquiries, quote requests, bulk orders, reseller opportunities, account applications, and online sales. Build targeted campaigns and lead-generation funnels for different industries, customer segments, product categories, and purchasing needs. Partner with sales and management teams to track leads from initial enquiry through conversion, improve lead quality, and introduce lead scoring, automated follow-up, and nurturing workflows. Create and optimise high-converting landing pages for retail, wholesale, reseller, corporate, and government audiences. Improve calls to action, forms, account applications, checkout journeys, and other conversion points through testing and behavioural analysis. Manage and optimise the e-commerce platform, including product information, descriptions, specifications, imagery, category structures, pricing, stock information, promotions, and customer journeys. Manage advertising budgets and continuously improve cost per qualified lead, customer acquisition cost, and return on advertising spend. jobgether-jobgether:lever:f9beb5b1-fd41-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Affiliate Partnerships Manager based in India. This is a fully remote opportunity focused on building and scaling affiliate partnerships as a high-impact growth channel. You will identify high-potential affiliates, publishers, influencers, comparison sites, and content creators, then turn those relationships into consistent subscriber growth. The role combines business development, relationship management, sales, performance analysis, and hands-on partner operations. You will own the partnership lifecycle end to end, from prospecting and outreach through demos, negotiation, onboarding, and ongoing performance optimization. AI-powered prospecting and monitoring tools will help you identify opportunities, prioritize partners, and scale your outreach efficiently. You will work in a small, globally distributed team where ownership, commercial results, and practical execution are highly valued. This is an independent contractor role with flexible remote working and a strong focus on subscriber growth and CAC efficiency. Prospect and acquire high-potential affiliate partners, including affiliates, comparison and review publishers, influencers, and content creators that align with the ideal partner profile. Build and nurture relationships with existing partners, increasing engagement, activity, subscriber generation, and long-term commercial value. Conduct product demonstrations and sales conversations with prospective partners, clearly communicating the product’s value proposition and influencing them to join the program. Own the outreach process end to end, managing a high-volume pipeline, maintaining conversations, and consistently following up until partners are signed and actively producing. Use affiliate management platforms such as Impact or similar tools to onboard partners, monitor activity and performance, and manage payouts. Leverage AI-powered prospecting and monitoring tools to identify, qualify, prioritize, and track partnership opportunities at scale. Monitor partner performance against subscriber growth and CAC targets, identifying high-performing relationships and reallocating effort where results are weaker. Maintain an organized and transparent partner pipeline with accurate records, clear statuses, and regular performance reporting. Collaborate with marketing leadership to align affiliate initiatives with broader campaigns, creative strategies, and customer lifecycle programs. Continuously identify new ways to improve affiliate acquisition, partner activation, conversion, and overall channel efficiency. Requirements 3–5+ years of experience in affiliate marketing, partnerships, business development, sales, or a related commercial function, ideally within B2C subscription businesses or fintech. Strong understanding of affiliate partnerships and the ability to identify, qualify, onboard, and develop commercially valuable partners. Experience with affiliate platforms such as Impact or similar solutions. Genuine experience with and understanding of stock investing, including fundamental analysis, portfolio management, and the mindset of long-term investors. Excellent written and spoken English, with the ability to communicate persuasively and adapt your tone across outreach, calls, demos, and relationship management. Strong sales and negotiation skills, with confidence in influencing prospects and closing partnership agreements. Exceptional relationship-building skills and a natural ability to turn cold contacts into engaged, productive partnerships. Highly organized and capable of managing a busy inbox, multiple partner conversations, follow-ups, and pipeline activities simultaneously.
